# Pre-extraction storage fixture

`v0.3.6/` contains synthetic data generated by the unmodified storage classes at
Git tag `v0.3.6` (`07c03423a494916e7e8e386388f42b4ab2033c16`). No personal data,
remote service or credentials were used. There is no released v0.4 tag in the
local repository; this is an old-format regression, not a v0.4 certification.

Generation used `RuntimeMemoryController.mutate`, `DocumentController.mutate`,
`MemoryBodyRegistry.updateProviderService/syncProviderService`, and
`HolographicProvider.remember`. Runtime, Documents and the namespace registry use
the fixed clock `2026-08-20T10:00:00.000Z`. The Provider's write uses its own clock.
Its discovery input is a synthetic stable namespace; `dataPath` is relative so
copies never address the original fixture's files.

The regression copies this tree to a disposable directory, mounts the actual
default composition with retained user configuration, checks non-mutating View
assembly, exercises old records through granted routes/actions, and reopens the
new writes. Keep these bytes as a historical fixture; do not regenerate them
with the new Source implementation to make a migration test pass.
